item.title: Non-Zero-Sum Games
item.description:
📝 Hi, I'm Non-Zero-Sum James, your companion on this exploration of win-win games and how they are essential for a better future. All the posts are connected through the lens of non-zero-sum games, but they fall into a few broad categories. You can start your journey with whatever appeals to you: Your thoughts and contributions are welcome.
🔗 Read more: https://nonzerosum.games/

item.title: Nicolas Guillou, French ICC judge sanctioned by the US and "debanked"
item.description:
📝 French judge Nicolas Guillou is sworn in at the headquarters of the International Criminal Court in The Hague, Netherlands, on March 8, 2024. COUR PENALE INTERNATIONALE Nicolas Guillou, a French judge at the International Criminal Court (ICC), was sanctioned by the United States under a decision made by Donald Trump on August 20. Among this long list are nine ICC judges.
🔗 Read more: https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2025/11/19/nicolas-guillou-french-icc-judge-sanctioned-by-the-us-you-are-effectively-blacklisted-by-much-of-the-world-s-banking-system_6747628_4.html
